[CRITICAL] Sustained Linux CPU Utilization Above 90 Percent fired — immediate action required

Use case: UC-1.1.1 — Sustained Linux CPU Utilization Above 90 Percent
Severity tier: high (urgent)

Immediate action required. Review the firing search, validate impact, and escalate per your runbook.

Reports one row per Linux host whose valid `cpu=all` samples have an arithmetic mean above 90 percentage points during a delayed, closed 60-minute window. Each row exposes the average, minimum, maximum, and number of admitted samples used by the threshold.
